title: The Path to Power
coreMove: Choose the invention or crux move that can create a barrier before optimizing operations around it.
sourcePressure: Operational excellence is not strategy. Firms often need invention or a crux directional choice before power can emerge, because me-too positioning leaves no barrier.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The path to power is to execute better, innovate vaguely, or become best-in-class at the current model.

sourceAnchors.name: me-too positioning
sourceAnchors.detail: the source sidecar says me-too positioning is insufficient because it leaves no barrier
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Me-too work can be polished and still powerless, because no rival has been forced into a worse position.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person 'You' direct address, retrospective 'It took her three weeks to see', question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps
